name: Squallglow
author: E. T. Carter
description: A night storm over a flooded plain: a towering cell left of centre spreads its anvil in a sheet across the sky toward a second cell on the right, and slow cold glows wander inside them, swelling to near-white and fading without ever flashing. Haze and a faint rain shaft hang under the cloud bases, a distant town warms the right horizon with ember light, and pools in the dark fields mirror the glows.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the glows wandering inside the storm cells, from dark silhouettes to clouds lit through.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: How fast the glows wander and swell and the cloud tops churn.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: Density of the lit haze lying between the near and far storm cells.

params.label: Rain
params.effect: Density of the rain shafts hanging under the cloud bases.
